description: This file implements a React component named EmojiManager which provides a UI for managing emojis, including viewing, searching, uploading, and deleting emojis. It interacts with an API service for fetching and modifying emoji data.

methods.name: normalizeList
methods.description: Normalizes raw emoji data into a consistent internal structure for rendering.

methods.name: seedCount
methods.description: Generates a usage count seed based on emoji content.

methods.name: ensureCounts
methods.description: Ensures each emoji has a usage count, updating state.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Fetches emoji data from the API and updates the component state.

methods.name: openAdd
methods.description: Opens the modal dialog to add a new emoji.

methods.name: onSave
methods.description: Handles the emoji upload process, including validation and API call.

methods.name: onRemove
methods.description: Removes an emoji entry via API call.
